integrity: Exact matrix proof and standard-library code provided. Numerical checks corroborate but are not substituted for the all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact Fourier rank and run criterion for the multiplicity-weighted vertex-sink distribution of all orientations of the labelled path only; no sharp nonzero multiplier magnitudes or arbitrary-tree theorem. Historical-priority comparison is bounded; independent validation is absent.
title: Four-state Fourier-rank law for acyclic-orientation sink profiles of paths
